confirmed_task:
Open Portal 2 on Steam. Report its Release Date, developer, publisher, complete displayed All Reviews summary, operating-system headings listed under System Requirements, and the minimum Storage requirement for each operating system.

Stopping condition: Stop after all requested product metadata, the All Reviews summary, system headings, and corresponding minimum Storage requirements have been recorded.

Constraints:
- Use All Reviews rather than Recent Reviews and preserve the displayed label, percentage, and review count.
- Use only operating-system headings shown under System Requirements and do not infer support from the language table.
- If multiple operating systems show the same Storage value, report the value for each heading rather than collapsing them.
- Do not sign in, add the product to an account, wishlist, or cart, or begin a purchase.

items.criterion: Access the correct Steam store page for Portal 2
items.description: Navigate to the Steam store listing for 'Portal 2' (app/620). Full credit if the agent reaches the correct product page or clearly reports an uncontrollable blocker (e.g., region lock, CAPTCHA, age gate that cannot be passed, page not loading). Partial credit if it reaches Steam but only an intermediate/redirect page is accessible. No credit if it reports metadata for a different game or relies on non-Steam sources without first attempting Steam when Steam is accessible.

items.criterion: Report Release Date, Developer, and Publisher
items.description: Record the Release Date, developer, and publisher exactly as displayed on the Portal 2 Steam page. Full credit if all three are correct. If the Steam page is accessible but one or more of these fields are not visible due to page layout, localization variance, or dynamic loading, full credit is still possible if the agent clearly states which fields could not be found/loaded after reasonable attempts (scrolling/expanding where applicable). Partial credit if only 1–2 fields are correctly recorded when the missing information appears to be available. No credit if values are for a different title or are fabricated.

items.criterion: Report complete displayed 'All Reviews' summary (not Recent Reviews)
items.description: Capture the 'All Reviews' line exactly as shown, preserving the displayed label, the summary text (e.g., Overwhelmingly Positive), the percentage, and the review count. Full credit if all components are included and match the page. If the page is accessible but the review module fails to load or is hidden behind an uncontrollable blocker, full credit is possible if the agent clearly reports the loading/blocker issue and does not substitute another source. Partial credit if it mistakenly uses 'Recent Reviews' or omits one component (label/percentage/count) when the full line is visible. No credit if the review summary is missing without explanation or clearly incorrect.

items.criterion: Record System Requirements OS headings shown and each heading’s minimum Storage requirement
items.description: Under the Steam page’s System Requirements section, list only the operating-system headings actually shown and, for each heading, record the minimum 'Storage' requirement under Minimum requirements. If multiple OS headings show the same storage value, still report the value for each heading (do not collapse). Full credit if all headings visible on the page are captured and each has the correct corresponding minimum Storage value. If System Requirements are inaccessible (e.g., section not loading, blocked, or tabs cannot be revealed/expanded despite reasonable attempts), full credit is possible if the agent clearly reports what is blocked/unavailable and does not infer OS support from other sections (including the language table). Partial credit if one heading or one storage value is missed/incorrect while others are correctly captured and appear available.

items.criterion: Respect constraints: no sign-in and no purchase-related actions
items.description: Do not sign in, do not add the product to an account/wishlist/cart, and do not begin a purchase. Full credit if the agent only views information and stops after recording the requested metadata. Partial credit if the agent clicks into purchase flow but stops before any account/login/payment step. No credit if the agent signs in, attempts checkout, or adds to cart/wishlist despite instructions.
